name: Contentful
description_en:
Contentful is a product in the Content management category. Its directory profile covers Template Creation, SEO Management, Search, Rule Based Publishing, Rich Text Editor, Permission Management, Indexing, Document Management.

Additional listed capabilities include Approval Process Control, Version Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $300.0. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: coordinate tasks intended to improve search discoverability; organize documents and control their access and revisions; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Contentful 属于内容管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括模板创建、搜索优化管理、搜索、按规则发布、富文本编辑器、权限管理、索引、文档管理。

资料还列出审批流程控制、版本控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $300.0. 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：协调改善搜索发现的相关工作；整理文档并管理访问权限与版本；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

community_follow_up.reason_en: The marketing origin previously returned 429. The support entry redirected to login; contentful.github.io unexpectedly redirected in the normal browser back to the previously restricted documentation origin. No further traversal occurred. This overview is insufficient to complete plan, quota and commercial research.
